scripts.dev: npm run build -w @learnspace/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @learnspace/shared" "npm run dev -w @learnspace/api" "npm run dev -w @learnspace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @learnspace/shared && npm run build -w @learnspace/ai && npm run build -w @learnspace/document-export && npm run build -w @learnspace/api && npm run build -w @learnspace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @learnspace/shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @learnspace/shared && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @learnspace/shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run db:validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
